name: @onurozkir/oracle-gateway
description: Independent, evidence-based verification of saved workspaces and Git commits

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/runtime packages/adapters packages/cli && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/runtime packages/adapters packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.lint: eslint packages tests scripts && prettier --check packages tests scripts bin/oracle-gate.js *.json *.mjs .github
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/test-package.mjs
scripts.demo:wrong: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/demo.ts wrong
scripts.demo:correct: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/demo.ts correct
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/benchmark.ts

author: Onur Özkır
